title: Add workspace-scoped mutex for checkpoint/restore/quickRollback
problem: Recovery operations mutate shared workspace state via git checkout/reset paths without explicit per-workspace serialization.
implementation_outline: Introduce workspace-level async mutex map in workflow engine runtime domain.
Wrap git-mutating sections in checkpoint restore/rollback paths with mutex guard.
Ensure lock release on success and failure paths.
acceptance_criteria: Concurrent restore/rollback on same workspace are serialized.
Different workspaces are not globally blocked.
